svg.title: HPC batch processing with AWS Batch
svg.desc: HPC batch processing with AWS Batch. 9 components in 5 groups. Connections: Researchers to Input and results (upload); Input and results to Object created rule (object created); Object created rule to AWS Step Functions; AWS Step Functions to AWS Batch; AWS Batch to AWS Batch compute environment (run jobs); Input and results to Amazon FSx for Lustre (import and export); Amazon FSx for Lustre to AWS Batch compute environment; AWS Batch to Amazon CloudWatch.

text.tspan: HPC BATCH PROCESSING WITH AWS BATCH
New input in Amazon S3 starts a workflow that runs AWS Batch jobs on Spot capacity over Amazon FSx for Lustre
